mapper.sql: id, stat_id, stat_period, stat_date, year, month, week, user_id, nick_name, avatar_url, hug_count, total_contribution, ranking, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hm_welfare_ranking ( stat_id, stat_period, stat_date, year, month, week, user_id, nick_name, avatar_url, hug_count, total_contribution, ranking, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{statId}, #{statPeriod}, #{statDate}, #{year}, #{month}, #{week}, #{userId}, #{nickName}, #{avatarUrl}, #{hugCount}, #{totalContribution}, #{ranking}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE hm_welfare_ranking SET nick_name = #{nickName}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, hug_count = #{hugCount}, total_contribution = #{totalContribution}, ranking = #{ranking}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT wc.date AS stat_date, wc.user_id, u.nick_name, u.avatar_url, SUM(wc.hug_count) AS hug_count, SUM(wc.contribution_value) AS total_contribution FROM hm_welfare_contribution wc LEFT JOIN hm_user u ON wc.user_id = u.user_id WHERE wc.date >= #{startDate} AND wc.date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY wc.date, wc.user_id ORDER BY total_contribution DESC

SELECT YEAR(wc.date) AS year, WEEK(wc.date, 3) AS week, DATE(DATE_SUB(wc.date, INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(wc.date) - 2) DAY)) AS stat_date, wc.user_id, u.nick_name, u.avatar_url, SUM(wc.hug_count) AS hug_count, SUM(wc.contribution_value) AS total_contribution FROM hm_welfare_contribution wc LEFT JOIN hm_user u ON wc.user_id = u.user_id WHERE wc.date >= #{startDate} AND wc.date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY YEAR(wc.date), WEEK(wc.date, 3), wc.user_id ORDER BY total_contribution DESC

SELECT YEAR(wc.date) AS year, MONTH(wc.date) AS month, DATE(DATE_FORMAT(wc.date, '%Y-%m-01')) AS stat_date, wc.user_id, u.nick_name, u.avatar_url, SUM(wc.hug_count) AS hug_count, SUM(wc.contribution_value) AS total_contribution FROM hm_welfare_contribution wc LEFT JOIN hm_user u ON wc.user_id = u.user_id WHERE wc.date >= #{startDate} AND wc.date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY YEAR(wc.date), MONTH(wc.date), wc.user_id ORDER BY total_contribution DESC

SELECT wc.user_id, u.nick_name, u.avatar_url, SUM(wc.hug_count) AS hug_count, SUM(wc.contribution_value) AS total_contribution FROM hm_welfare_contribution wc LEFT JOIN hm_user u ON wc.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY wc.user_id ORDER BY total_contribution DESC LIMIT 100
